scope: Primary decompiled Ref item-detail window placement and message-24 update behavior.
conclusion: Ref supports retained/default or previously saved placement. Right-click callers pass an ITEM_INFO snapshot without cursor coordinates. UIWindowMgr.MakeWindow shows the detail window before the caller sends message 24, so normal source behavior does not use a preferred cursor position.

references: Right-click detail callers pass val2=0; selected-item fallback callers around8492,9205,9894,12454,13104 pass val2=1.

placement.initial_manager_move: UIX(185), UICY(300), then add window and initialize stored info; Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:5145-5150.
placement.valid_saved_rectangle: w must equal 280, h must equal 120, x must be within [0, renderer.width-280], and y within [0, renderer.height-120]; Ref/UIRectInfo.cpp:297-309.
placement.first_open_default_move: If stored geometry is invalid, move to (default.x + (renderer.width-640)/2, renderer.width*default.y/640); Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9615-9621.
placement.stored_move: If stored geometry is valid, restore its x/y; Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9609-9613.
placement.persistence: StoreInfo saves x, y, w, h only; Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:23313-23324. UIWindowMgr reads/writes the itemCollectionWndInfo fields; Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:11036-11039 and 13013-13016.
placement.message_24_position_effect: No move or preferred-coordinate handling occurs in message 24. Updating the displayed item retains the window's current x/y.
placement.normal_open_order: MakeWindow case 12 creates or retrieves the window, sends initialization on first creation, calls SetShow(1), and returns; the caller then sends message 24. Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:5131-5151.

message_24.toggle_predicate: Close/delete the detail window only if the full stored m_itemInfo.m_itemName string compares equal to the incoming val1->m_itemName string, m_refiningLevel matches, all four m_slot values match, and val2 is zero; Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9335-9349.
message_24.identity_caveat: The toggle compares the m_itemName field plus refining and card-slot fields. It does not compare m_itemIndex, GetItemId(), or identification state in this predicate.
message_24.force_update: Any nonzero val2 bypasses the same-item close predicate and continues through item assignment/update.
message_24.zero_val2_callers: The observed primary right-click detail calls in Ref/UIItemWnd.cpp and Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp pass val2=0. They pass item snapshots and no cursor x/y values.

dynamic_size.with_identified_slots: Resize to height 149 when identified and having slots, unless the current height equals 144; Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9359-9366.
dynamic_size.otherwise: Resize to height 120 unless the current height already equals 120; Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9367-9373.
dynamic_size.decompiler_note: The identified-slot branch checks current height 144 but resizes to 149. Preserve this as an observed decompiler oddity; do not normalize the check without independent evidence.
